userStories.title: praxis week and its flags
acceptanceCriteria: `praxis week`, `--week <iso>`, `--dry-run`, `--frontier-only`, `--explain-judging`, `--notify`, and `--write-html` are wired to the orchestrator with documented behavior
`--week` accepts ISO-week strings like 2026-W21 and renders a past week's data
userStories.notes: Added run_weekly() in praxis/orchestrator.py as the CLI seam; cmd_week + week subparser in praxis/cli/__main__.py; tests in tests/test_cli.py.

userStories.title: Auxiliary commands present
acceptanceCriteria: `praxis re-score <session_stable_id>` re-runs the frontier judge for that session and updates session_scores
`praxis baseline`, `praxis follow-up`, `praxis history`, `praxis show <week_iso>` are wired to read-only operations and exit 0
`praxis scan` performs scan + score without rendering a digest
`praxis status`, `praxis rubric`, `praxis models` are preserved from v0.1
userStories.notes: Added re_score_session() + list_persisted_weeks() in orchestrator.py and load_one_session_score() in profile_store.py as the CLI seams. cmd_re_score / cmd_baseline / cmd_history / cmd_show + their subparsers in praxis/cli/__main__.py. scan now prints a one-line progress summary instead of rendering the digest. Tests in tests/test_cli.py (14 new).

userStories.title: Exit code 2 when no API key is configured
acceptanceCriteria: When neither Anthropic nor OpenAI credentials are available, the CLI exits with code 2 and prints a clear message naming both env vars
userStories.notes: Added has_api_key_configured() + NO_API_KEY_MESSAGE in orchestrator.py as the CLI seam. cmd_week gates on it only for the judge-using path (no --week, no --dry-run); cmd_scan always gates. Read-only verbs (baseline/history/show/follow-up) skip the gate. cmd_re_score already returned exit 2 via ReScoreError('no_judge') from US-075, so left untouched. 8 new tests in tests/test_cli.py cover the matrix (week/scan no-key exit 2, week --week / --dry-run / baseline / history bypass, Anthropic-only / OpenAI-only proceed).

userStories.title: Exit code 3 when no sessions in the window
acceptanceCriteria: If the scan returns zero in-window sessions, the CLI exits with code 3 and prints a clear message
userStories.notes: Added no_sessions_message() helper in orchestrator.py as the CLI seam. cmd_week and cmd_show now exit 3 with a clear message naming the targeted ISO week when summary.snapshot.session_count == 0. The gate runs AFTER the US-076 exit-2 gate (no API key trumps no sessions). cmd_scan deliberately does NOT exit 3 -- it is the cron-driven data-mover; a scheduled run that finds 0 sessions should not surface as a job failure. 7 new tests in tests/test_cli.py cover: current-week / past-week / dry-run all exit 3, show exits 3, precedence (no key trumps no sessions), positive case with seeded data still exits 0, scan with no sessions still exits 0. Four existing API-key-bypass tests now assert code != 2 (the original intent: the gate was bypassed) rather than == 0 (which no longer holds without seeded data).
